name: Keen Fangs
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 4, ranger 3, shaman 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature with natural attacks per level no two which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration concentration + 1 round
Saving Throw no (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You cause claws and fangs to deal more grievous wounds. You invest the targeted creatures with primal power increasing the threat range of all natural weapons they possess by one. For example if a creature possesses a claw attack with a critical threat range of 19-20/x2 this spell increases the range to 18-20/x2. This increase stacks with effects such as the Improved Critical feat but is applied last.
